name: LogForge Unicron
longDescription:
All in one UI, for Docker. Real-time logs, Interactive terminals, Custom alerts/notifications/Automations, File system access through enrolled agents.

Security notice: writable Docker socket access grants LogForge root-equivalent control of the Cosmos Docker host. Central uses this access for automatic local agent deployment and appliance self-update. Agents use Docker access for container operations, terminals, file access, and automation on their hosts. These are trusted administrator capabilities; only grant LogForge administrator access to trusted users.

Agent enrollment uses logforge/unicron-agent:latest. For manual enrollment, pull the image on the agent host before running its enrollment command.

Build transparency: The appliance packages Python services with PyInstaller. Source and build recipes are available in the linked source repository. This listing does not attest reproducible builds, source-to-image equivalence, or SBOM availability; verify any release provenance and SBOM with the publisher.
description: All-in-one Docker observability and operations UI.
